html:
Mortimer is a junior clerk of the Shayland Bank branch in Crystal Fall, south of the Duchy of Almera. In the chapter "Satellite - 4" ("A Doll on the Throne", February 1775), the raid of the Satellites on this compartment is shown by his eyes.

"A Doll on the Throne"

The chapter begins with Mortimer at the ledger shortly before the branch closes. Five years ago, the boss described his duties: write down the name, title and amount in the book and take the client to the cash register. The main task, as Mortimer soon became convinced, turned out to be "swan" - in front of customers, in front of the boss and even in front of the burglar guards, who "could quite count all the ribs to Mortimer." At home, his wife was waiting for him with two kids (Jod and Liz). He had long convinced his wife that the branch closed at eight rather than seven, and spent an extra hour with the second clerk, Hagen, in a beer shop, where they laughed at customers and assembled a "collection of customer idiocy."

A quarter of an hour before seven, two people entered the hall: a southerner in a white fox fur coat, who called himself a Shimmerian merchant, and his “slave” Charlotte. Mortimer accepted a bill of twenty ephemera, issued by the Farway branch, and began to write it down in a book. In his mind, he envied the merchant who “unquestioningly commands his woman.” When the “slave” was outraged by the commission in one twentieth, he referred to the rules of the bank, and then called the boss to resolve the dispute. In the cash register, while Mortimer looked at the bill, the “slave” threw two knives at the guards, the southerner stunned the boss and grabbed the cashier. Mortimer was unsupervised for a second, but spent it to realize what had happened, and said: "Holy gods!"

Mortimer knew there was a 2,000-hilt reserve in the vault and a hidden fifth guard with a crossbow, and he didn't know whether to lie to him or tell the truth. When the shot from the secret vent finally opened the guard, the southern man put the clerk in front of him as a human shield. Mortimer then took a bag of gold out of the vault with the cashier. From the outside they saw that the guards at the door were killed, and Hagen was lying on the table, filling the account book with blood, and that the Shavans of the Gants of Biray were in the hall. A companion in a hat and glasses (the Sorcerer) ordered the two to be killed, but Chara let them go, and Mortimer, "pushing his head into his shoulders", passed by the raised sword. One of the narrow-eyed men measured up when the southerner said, "Just try it."

Mortimer ran through the snowy city until he stopped at the town hall, where the clock struck half-eight. He went to the pub, ordered hot wine and decided not to tell his wife anything: all his experience said that it is better to be silent about the unusual house. This is his last appearance; the chapter goes on to talk of the Wizard and the Chara in the forest.

Trivia

  • The Crystal Fall raid is the first of the Sorcerer's raids on the banks of the Earl of Shayland. The southerner from this chapter is Neymir, posing as a merchant. (Neimir)
